breakdown.description: The pipe is simultaneously described as horizontal/same elevation and having a 15 m elevation difference (contradictory geometry).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the contradiction between the pipe being described as 'horizontal' and having a '15 m' elevation difference. It resolved this by explicitly stating, 'The pipe is not horizontal; ignore the earlier "horizontal" description,' which aligns with the ground truth's correction to treat the pipe as having an elevation difference.
